# Technorage

> The personal site of Deepu K Sasidharan: posts on local LLMs, Rust, Java, Kubernetes, Linux, and OAuth, plus the terminal tools he maintains.

This site is written and maintained by Deepu K Sasidharan (deepu105), a Principal Developer Advocate at Auth0 (Okta) in Utrecht, Netherlands. He is creator of LlamaStash, KDash, and JWT UI, co-chair of JHipster, a Java Champion (2022), and author of Full Stack Development with JHipster (Packt). Everything here is his own opinion, not his employer's.

Contact: deepu.k.sasidharan@gmail.com
Profiles: https://github.com/deepu105, https://www.linkedin.com/in/deepu05, https://bsky.app/profile/deepu105.bsky.social, https://mastodon.social/@deepu105, https://x.com/deepu105, https://dev.to/deepu105, https://speakerdeck.com/deepu105, https://auth0.com/blog/authors/deepu-sasidharan/
RSS: https://deepu.tech/feed.xml
Sitemap: https://deepu.tech/sitemap-index.xml
Full post index: https://deepu.tech/llms-full.txt

## Projects

- [LlamaStash](https://github.com/llamastash/llamastash): Rust TUI, CLI, daemon, and OpenAI-compatible proxy for running local LLMs on llama.cpp and friends.
- [KDash](https://github.com/kdash-rs/kdash): Kubernetes dashboard in the terminal, written in Rust.
- [JWT UI](https://github.com/jwt-rs/jwt-ui): terminal UI for decoding and encoding JSON Web Tokens.
- [JHipster](https://www.jhipster.tech): application generator for Spring Boot plus React, Angular, or Vue. He is co-chair and vice-president.
- [JDL Studio](https://start.jhipster.tech/jdl-studio/): online editor for the JHipster Domain Language.
- [auth0-token-vault-cli](https://github.com/deepu105/auth0-token-vault-cli): use Auth0 Token Vault from AI agents without the agent holding user tokens.
- [Assistant0](https://github.com/auth0-samples/auth0-assistant0): sample AI assistant that reaches Gmail and Slack through Auth0.

## Series

- [Languages](https://deepu.tech/series/languages/): Impressions and comparisons of programming languages, and why I stay polyglot instead of picking a favorite.
- [Memory Management](https://deepu.tech/series/memory-management/): How memory management works, from the fundamentals up through the JVM, V8, Go, and Rust.
- [Concurrency in Modern Programming Languages](https://deepu.tech/series/concurrency-in-modern-programming-languages/): Building and benchmarking the same concurrent web server in Rust, Go, Node.js, Deno, Java, and Kotlin to compare concurrency.
- [Functional Programming](https://deepu.tech/series/functional-programming/): Functional programming applied in Java, Go, TypeScript, and Rust, with real examples.
- [Golang for JavaScript Developers](https://deepu.tech/series/golang-for-javascript-developers/): Learning Go from a JavaScript developer's point of view, one concept at a time.
- [Microservices with JHipster](https://deepu.tech/series/microservices-with-jhipster/): Building microservice architectures with JHipster, Kubernetes, and Istio, end to end.
- [GNU/Linux Environment for Developers](https://deepu.tech/series/gnu-linux-environment-for-developers/): My GNU/Linux setup for development: Arch, windowing, terminals, and the tools I use.
- [Passkeys](https://deepu.tech/series/passkeys/): How WebAuthn and passkeys work for developers, and how to add them to Java apps.
- [Local AI](https://deepu.tech/series/local-ai/): Running LLMs on my own laptop for day-to-day coding: the setup, LlamaStash, benchmarks, and how local models compare with frontier cloud models.
